title: Sport and Simulation handling for ATVs and motorcycles
summary: In a local ride, open Settings → Game Settings → Physics. Sport gives the tires more grip for fast corners. Simulation makes it easier to use up the grip available for turning when accelerating or braking.
details: Each tire has its own load and tread. Sustained sliding wears the loaded tire, and Game Settings shows the remaining tread of the most worn tire. Six 600-step host runs on Caribou Peak exercised acceleration, cornering and braking on an ATV and a Suzuki RM125 across all three modes. Both optional modes accumulated wear. Original recorded zero wear.
limitation: These are authored presets tuned for play. Wear covers tires during a ride. Calibration against instrumented vehicles and physical-phone handling tests remain open. Online rooms use Original.
